prompt.zh: 美的世界对我来说很重要。
prompt.en: Feel it's important to live in a world of beauty.

prompt.zh: 看到美的事物时，我会产生深刻的情感。
prompt.en: Experience deep emotions when I see beautiful things.

prompt.zh: 我很少留意环境中的自然美。
prompt.en: Am rarely aware of the natural beauty in the environment.

prompt.zh: 在别人提起之前，我往往注意不到美。
prompt.en: Fail to notice beauty until others comment on it.

prompt.zh: 我知道，生活中有人像关心自己一样关心我。
prompt.en: Know that there are people in my life who care as much for me as for themselves.

prompt.zh: 我能向别人表达爱。
prompt.en: Can express love to someone else.

prompt.zh: 我不容易与别人分享自己的感受。
prompt.en: Do not easily share my feelings with others.

prompt.zh: 我难以接受任何人给予的爱。
prompt.en: Have difficulty accepting love from anyone.

prompt.zh: 我是一个非常忠诚的人。
prompt.en: Am an extremely loyal person.

prompt.zh: 我支持队友或其他小组成员。
prompt.en: Support my teammates or fellow group members.

prompt.zh: 我不擅长在团队中工作。
prompt.en: Am not good at working with a group.

prompt.zh: 我更喜欢独自做所有事情。
prompt.en: Prefer to do everything alone.

prompt.zh: 许多不同的活动都让我感到兴奋。
prompt.en: Am excited by many different activities.

prompt.zh: 在任何情境中，我都能找到感兴趣的事物。
prompt.en: Can find something of interest in any situation.

prompt.zh: 我对这个世界并没有那么好奇。
prompt.en: Am not all that curious about the world.

prompt.zh: 我的兴趣不多。
prompt.en: Have few interests.

prompt.zh: 我平等对待所有人。
prompt.en: Treat all people equally.

prompt.zh: 我相信每个人的权利都同样重要。
prompt.en: Believe that everyone's rights are equally important.

prompt.zh: 我会占别人的便宜。
prompt.en: Take advantage of others.

prompt.zh: 如果不喜欢某个人，我对待这个人的方式就会不同。
prompt.en: Treat others differently if I don't like them.

prompt.zh: 别人对我不好时，我尽量以理解回应。
prompt.en: Try to respond with understanding when someone treats me badly.

prompt.zh: 我允许别人重新开始。
prompt.en: Allow others to make a fresh start.

prompt.zh: 我会记仇。
prompt.en: Hold grudges.

prompt.zh: 我发现很难原谅别人。
prompt.en: Find it hard to forgive others.

prompt.zh: 我向关心我的人表达感谢。
prompt.en: Express my thanks to those who care about me.

prompt.zh: 我是一个非常懂得感恩的人。
prompt.en: Am an extremely grateful person.

prompt.zh: 我对别人没有感激之情。
prompt.en: Feel no gratitude to others.

prompt.zh: 我觉得生活中值得感激的事情很少。
prompt.en: Find few things in my life to be grateful for.

prompt.zh: 在别人看来消极的事情中，我能找到积极的一面。
prompt.en: Can find the positive in what seems negative to others.

prompt.zh: 面对挑战，我仍抱有希望。
prompt.en: Remain hopeful despite challenges.

prompt.zh: 我预期最坏的结果。
prompt.en: Expect the worst.

prompt.zh: 我常想到那些不太可能发生的负面结果。
prompt.en: Often think about the possibility of negative outcomes that are not likely to occur.

prompt.zh: 我用笑声让别人的日子更明亮。
prompt.en: Use laughter to brighten the days of others.

prompt.zh: 即使在低沉的情境中，我仍保有幽默感。
prompt.en: Keep my sense of humor even in gloomy situations.

prompt.zh: 我并不以有幽默感而著称。
prompt.en: Am not known for my sense of humor.

prompt.zh: 和我相处并不好玩。
prompt.en: Am not fun to be with.

prompt.zh: 任务没有完成之前，我不会放弃。
prompt.en: Don't quit a task before it is finished.

prompt.zh: 即使遇到障碍，我也会把事情完成。
prompt.en: Finish things despite obstacles in the way.

prompt.zh: 我没有完成自己开始做的事情。
prompt.en: Don't finish what I start.

prompt.zh: 我容易放弃。
prompt.en: Give up easily.

prompt.zh: 别人信任我会保守秘密。
prompt.en: Am trusted to keep secrets.

prompt.zh: 我信守承诺。
prompt.en: Keep my promises.

prompt.zh: 我撒谎来让自己摆脱麻烦。
prompt.en: Lie to get myself out of trouble.

prompt.zh: 我欺骗信任过我的人。
prompt.en: Cheat on people who have trusted me.

prompt.zh: 我会权衡利弊。
prompt.en: Weigh the pro's and the con's.

prompt.zh: 朋友看重我的判断力。
prompt.en: Am valued by my friends for my good judgment.

prompt.zh: 我不太会批判性地思考事情。
prompt.en: Don't tend to think things through critically.

prompt.zh: 作决定时，我不会考虑不同的可能性。
prompt.en: Don't think about different possibilities when making decisions.

prompt.zh: 我从不会忙到没有时间帮助朋友。
prompt.en: Am never too busy to help a friend.

prompt.zh: 对于看起来情绪低落的人，我会特意做些事让他们振作。
prompt.en: Go out of my way to cheer up people who appear down.

prompt.zh: 别人向我讲他们的问题时，我会变得不耐烦。
prompt.en: Get impatient when others talk to me about their problems.

prompt.zh: 我只对那些对我好过的人友善。
prompt.en: Am only kind to others if they have been kind to me.

prompt.zh: 我擅长帮助大家良好合作。
prompt.en: Am good at helping people work well together.

prompt.zh: 别人说我是一个有力而公平的领导者。
prompt.en: Am told that I am a strong but fair leader.

prompt.zh: 我难以让别人一起工作。
prompt.en: Have difficulty getting others to work together.

prompt.zh: 我不擅长负责带领一个团队。
prompt.en: Am not good at taking charge of a group.

prompt.zh: 我确实是一个终身学习者。
prompt.en: Am a true life-long learner.

prompt.zh: 学到新东西时，我很兴奋。
prompt.en: Am thrilled when I learn something new.

prompt.zh: 我不喜欢学习新东西。
prompt.en: Don't like to learn new things.

prompt.zh: 我不会为了乐趣而阅读非虚构书籍。
prompt.en: Don't read nonfiction books for fun.

prompt.zh: 我不吹嘘自己的成就。
prompt.en: Don't brag about my accomplishments.

prompt.zh: 别人绝不会把我描述为傲慢的人。
prompt.en: Would never be described as arrogant.

prompt.zh: 我喜欢在人群中引人注目。
prompt.en: Like to stand out in a crowd.

prompt.zh: 我喜欢谈论自己。
prompt.en: Like to talk about myself.

prompt.zh: 我会想出做事情的新方法。
prompt.en: Come up with new ways to do things.

prompt.zh: 我是一个有原创想法的人。
prompt.en: Am an original thinker.

prompt.zh: 别人不认为我有新颖而不同的想法。
prompt.en: Am not considered to have new and different ideas.

prompt.zh: 我并没有特别想做出原创东西的冲动。
prompt.en: Have no special urge to do something original.

prompt.zh: 我对人生有成熟的看法。
prompt.en: Have a mature view on life.

prompt.zh: 别人认为我是一个有智慧的人。
prompt.en: Am considered to be a wise person.

prompt.zh: 我不擅长弄清楚什么才是真正重要的。
prompt.en: Am not good at figuring out what really matters.

prompt.zh: 别人很少来征求我的建议。
prompt.en: Am rarely consulted for advice by others.

prompt.zh: 我相信，小心一些总比事后后悔好。
prompt.en: Believe it is always better to be safe than sorry

prompt.zh: 我谨慎作出选择。
prompt.en: Make careful choices.

prompt.zh: 我还没想清楚后果就采取行动。
prompt.en: Act before thinking through the consequences.

prompt.zh: 我喜欢冒险。
prompt.en: Like taking risks.

prompt.zh: 我是一个高度自律的人。
prompt.en: Am a highly disciplined person.

prompt.zh: 即使某些事情能让我短暂感觉良好，只要它们长远来看对我有害，我就会放弃。
prompt.en: Forego things that are bad for me in the long run even if they make me feel good in the short run.

prompt.zh: 我会让花费过多或进食过多的冲动控制自己。
prompt.en: Let myself be taken over by urges to spend or eat too much.

prompt.zh: 我会屈从于自己的冲动。
prompt.en: Give in to my urges.

prompt.zh: 我擅长感知别人的感受。
prompt.en: Am good at sensing what others are feeling.

prompt.zh: 我知道说什么能让别人感觉良好。
prompt.en: Know what to say to make people feel good.

prompt.zh: 在新的社交场合，我不知道该如何表现。
prompt.en: Don't know how to handle myself in a new social situation.

prompt.zh: 我难以猜到别人会怎样反应。
prompt.en: Have trouble guessing how others will react.

prompt.zh: 我是一个有精神信仰的人。
prompt.en: Am a spiritual person.

prompt.zh: 我相信，每个人的人生都有其目的。
prompt.en: Believe that each person has a purpose in life.

prompt.zh: 我觉得人生没有意义。
prompt.en: Feel that life has no meaning.

prompt.zh: 我不相信有普遍性的力量或神。
prompt.en: Do not believe in a universal power or a God.

prompt.zh: 面对强烈反对时，我曾多次坚持自己的立场。
prompt.en: Have taken frequent stands in the face of strong opposition.

prompt.zh: 我毫不犹豫地表达不受欢迎的观点。
prompt.en: Don't hesitate to express an unpopular opinion.

prompt.zh: 我不为自己的信念挺身而出。
prompt.en: Do not stand up for my beliefs.

prompt.zh: 如果可能有不好的后果，我就不会坦率地表达想法。
prompt.en: Don't speak my mind freely when there might be negative results.

prompt.zh: 醒来时，我对一天中的各种可能性感到兴奋。
prompt.en: Awaken with a sense of excitement about the day's possibilities.

prompt.zh: 我期待每一个新的一天。
prompt.en: Look forward to each new day.

prompt.zh: 别人把我描述为脾气不佳的人。
prompt.en: Am described as grumpy.

prompt.zh: 我的精力不多。
prompt.en: Don't have much energy.

prompt.zh: 美的世界对我来说很重要。
prompt.en: Feel it's important to live in a world of beauty.
